certificate_guided_dn_preservation.comparison_permission: DRT may compare while preserving certificate-guided DN evidence as sibling artifacts.
certificate_guided_dn_preservation.not_claimed: Certificate-guided artifacts remain independent sibling evidence.

dgt_replay_claim_status.not_claimed: No production deployment or global model superiority is claimed.

DGT-REPLAY-HG0-owner-ready.evidence: model-comparison owner must be ready before DGT replay can promote.

DGT-REPLAY-HG1.evidence: Formal replay arm catalog must contain the exact public arm set.

DGT-REPLAY-HG2.evidence: Training replay bridge must emit one public row for each formal arm.

DGT-REPLAY-HG3.evidence: Replay rows must carry matched parameter counts.

DGT-REPLAY-HG4.evidence: Replay rows must carry matched compute budgets.

DGT-REPLAY-HG5.evidence: Matched-random structural control must be explicitly randomized.

DGT-REPLAY-HG6.evidence: DGT_full must have positive classifier shift.

DGT-REPLAY-HG7.evidence: DGT_full must carry a net-positive replay signal.

DGT-REPLAY-HG8.evidence: Matched-random classifier shift must remain zero.

DRT-HG1.evidence: DRT must reduce debt while preserving benefit.

DRT-HG2.evidence: Quality promotion boundary clears DRT over task-only while benefit is nondecreasing.

DRT-HG3.evidence: Classifier shift and net positive signal are both recorded.

DRT-HG4.evidence: DRT certificate loss improves over matched-random control.

DRT-HG6.evidence: Bounded PyTorch training evidence must be available, protocol-complete, and positive against matched-random control.

DRT-HG7.evidence: DRT may compare against certificate-guided baselines only while preserving their sibling DN evidence and isolating terminal verdict semantics.

DRT-HG8.evidence: The deterministic mechanism ablation must preserve all six owner-local arms, resolved comparison pointers, full DRT separation, a positive full mechanism signal, and no net-positive ablation parity.

DRT-HG9.evidence: D5-M promotion requires the DRT-local training mechanism certificate to pass with all owner-local pointers resolved.

DRTJ-HG1.evidence: Jet arm must improve the required order while matched-random jet remains negative.

DRTJ-HG2.evidence: Jet objective must not degrade order-1 behavior.

DRTJ-HG3.evidence: High-order gain must not be reducible to a shortcut witness flip.

DRTJ-HG4.evidence: Matched-random jet control must remain negative.

DRTJ-HG5.evidence: Jet quality_q CI-low must remain positive on the frontier.

positive_claim.scope: canonical deterministic anchor with bounded optional PyTorch evidence
positive_claim.text: Discovery-regularized training records a bounded lab-local positive signal under deterministic replay and matched-random controls.

hardgate.requirement: DRT quality_q CI-low must be strictly above task_only quality_q.

revocation_rows.condition: revoke if deterministic replay changes rounded metric summaries beyond tolerance
revoke if matched-random certificate loss is no longer worse than DRT certificate loss
revoke if any task-accuracy-only row is promoted as discovery evidence

training_replay_bridge.not_claimed: Toy replay bridge only; no production deployment or global model superiority is claimed.

what_was_learned: The deterministic anchor records debt reduction, benefit preservation, classifier shift, and matched-random certificate separation.
